summary: Managed sales and support agents with CRM handoffs, knowledge-gap analysis, and deployment support.
editor_note: The practical bet is deployment work rather than another self-serve chatbot builder. Agents connect knowledge, CRM and booking handoffs, while the knowledge-gap view groups weak answers into documentation fixes. Forward-deployed support and private deployment options address operational constraints. The open question is whether hands-on deployments can scale without becoming a bespoke services business.
why_featured: CA$3.2M Seed for deployed AI agents
investors: UpHonest Capital, Amino Capital, Welight Capital, UpScaleX, AltaIR Capital

sources.label: Expertise AI via Canada Newswire funding announcement

product_evidence.claim: The product connects agents to knowledge, CRM, booking and human escalation with forward-deployed implementation support and private VPS options.
The knowledge-gap workflow flags low-confidence or incomplete answers, groups recurring themes and uses resolution data to prioritize documentation fixes.

market_context.primary_user: Traditional-industry sales and support teams needing deployment assistance.
market_context.differentiation: Combines knowledge feedback with implementation support rather than treating installation as adoption.
market_context.why_now: Canadian-dollar Seed financing supports an inspectable deployment and maintenance workflow.

risks.claim: Hands-on delivery may constrain margins and repeatability.
risks.basis: Editorial assessment of the forward-deployed model; public customer outcomes are company reported.
